partnership_angle: Referral partner with a design-partner feeder motion. Consilium Labs is a ~15-person, founder-led boutique founded in 2020 that already runs its practice on GRC automation (dedicated Vanta, Drata, and Secureframe partner pages) and explicitly sells cheap, fast audits to startups and SaaS teams — exactly the pre-audit pipeline LoxeAI needs. Because they are also an accredited ISO 42001/27001 certification body, one relationship covers SOC 2 plus AI-governance referrals. Their whole brand is 'automation-driven efficiency,' so a scanner that pre-cleans AWS environments before evidence collection strengthens their pitch rather than threatening it. Caveats: leadership appears Israel-rooted (GRSee spin-off), so expect a distributed team, and AWS depth is implied rather than proven — validate on the first call.
pitch_note: You've built the audit experience startups actually want — startup pricing, Vanta/Drata/Secureframe integrations, SLAs that hold. LoxeAI is an AWS-native SOC 2 readiness scanner for exactly those lean cloud teams: we'd love 30 minutes to have your auditors run it against a sandbox (or your own AWS account) and tear it apart. If it holds up to your standards, your pre-audit pipeline gets a simple play — 'run this scan first, it gets you ~80% ready' — so clients arrive cleaner, audits close faster, and your Vanta-speed positioning gets even sharper.
